# vcop2 (Virtua Cop 2; Model 2A-CRX): entry points the recompiler cannot find by
# itself. The MAME harvest (scripts/run_trace.sh's branches.txt: the targets of indirect
# branches, calls and balx, the interrupt handlers and the IAC target) over 3,600 frames
# of attract and a scripted 9,000-frame game (shots across the screen, reloads), the
# test mode and the continue; the
# interrupted addresses are not seeds. Addresses only (our own analysis; rules.md rule 7).

# The continue (18 Oct 2026): MAME harvests of a game where the player dies and
# continues (coin, start), and of one left to game over; the console stopped on
# 0x2faac. The print routine 0x4350-0x4408 is called as balx 0x43xx,r14 with
# its text inline after the call, and returns past it (0x4408 bx (r14): the
# words up to the first one <= 0xffffff): every such return point, computed
# from the 193 calls in the program ROM (6 were already seeds), then the
# harvest's other new targets.
000012c8
